Name: Dino Mayo Tweak
Author: Poplinp
Description:
[size=3]Basically fixing something that was bugging me for a while :))

A small mod to tweak the price of Dinosaur Mayonnaise to keep it profitable after reading the 'Treasure Appraisal Guide' book.
Dino Mayo will be affected by the book in the same way artifacts are, a x3 sell price multiplier. Profession multipliers still apply.[/size]

[b]
[color=#d9ead3][size=4]Original Prices [/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Base Dino Egg: 350g
Base Dino Egg after reading book: 1050g
Dino Mayo: 800g
Base Dino Mayo after reading book: 800g => [b][color=#d9ead3]NEVER profitable to turn Dino Egg into mayo[/color][/b][/size]
[b]
[/b][b][color=#d9ead3][size=4]Tweaked Prices [/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Base Dino Egg: 350g
Base Dino Egg after reading book: 1050g
Dino Mayo: 800g
Base Dino Mayo after reading book: 2400g => [b][color=#d9ead3]ALWAYS profitable to turn Dino Egg into mayo[/color][/b][/size]

[size=2]*Prices not taking into account Artisan or Rancher professions, though they don't change much. Artisan [b]does [/b]make vanilla Dino Mayo from [b]normal quality only[/b] Dino Eggs slightly profitable.

[/size][size=3][i]Please note:[/i] This mod patches the game code (harmony patching) to fix the sell price, and SMAPI will show it as such.[/size][size=2]
[/size]
source code is [url=https://github.com/shirimishor/PoplinpStardewMods/tree/main/DinoMayoTweak]here[/url].
